description: Scenario Planning for Crops and Cattle is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by University of Nebraska–Lincoln Institute of Agriculture and Natural Resources, Extension; South Dakota State University Extension; USDA Northern Plains Climate Hub. Crop and cattle producers can select a season and a scenario and get tips to increase resilience for each condition. Strategies in the tool were compiled for Nebraska and South Dakota, but may be useful in other areas. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
